northwind.name: Northwind founder series
northwind.creativeBrief: Dark cinematic typography with film grain. Calm, elegant motion. Data-driven: charts are welcome when there are numbers. No bouncy motion.
northwind.brandingNotes: Gold accents only. Underlines for key phrases.

lumen.creativeBrief: Clean, minimal paper texture look over a warm background. Punchy and energetic. No charts. No typewriter text.
